tips.text: Set your real height, weight and length. Most "GPS sent me under a bridge" stories trace back to default truck settings.

tips.text: New developments put up weight-limit and no-truck signs long before maps catch up. The sign on the pole wins.

tips.text: Parking is drivers' #1 issue in ATRI's 2024 survey, and drivers average about 56 minutes a day looking for a spot. Pick your shutdown spot early.
